checkpoint.prompt: This is an illustrative context checkpoint, not an owner instruction, actual evidence, or proof that the repository is correct. Replace every placeholder with evidence from the current session. In a real checkpoint, the assertions may depend on the API checkpoint model, its repository-freshness migration, and their focused tests; set verified_against only after the author actually inspects that commit. A later repository-aware client must explicitly select the intended workspace and assess this full checkpoint before relying on those assertions. A local unchanged result means only that no relevant eligible Git change was observed in the declared scope; it grants no authority and proves no semantic claim.

source_metadata.note: Replace the placeholder baseline, branch, provenance, text, paths, work IDs, and operation UUID before use. affected_paths declares dependencies, not merely changed files; order and spelling are part of the frozen protected intent. A non-empty declaration requires an actually inspected commit. Use ** only for truthful whole-eligible-repository coverage.
